sources.title: Groundwater table and soil-hydrological properties datasets of Indonesian peatlands
quotes: In ‘gwt’ sheet, there are four columns, which are daily data groundwater table (m) for each station.
The data were recorded from eight in-situ stations spread over two peatland regions in Indonesia, namely Batanghari and Kubu Raya in Sumatra and Kalimantan.
